examples.vi: Một con thỏ nhanh chóng biến mất vào bụi rậm rạp.

senses.vi: tầng cây bụi; bụi rậm

thesaurus.definition: the brush (small trees and bushes and ferns etc.) growing beneath taller trees in a wood or forest

vi_block: Sự chậm lớn, sự còi cọc.

examples: tangled undergrowth
clear the undergrowth
wiktionary.gloss: The plants in a forest which only reach a relatively low height (such as shrubs and bushes).

senses.definition: Describing a place that is beautiful and has not been damaged by modern buildings or people.

examples.en: They enjoyed walking through the unspoiled countryside.
examples.vi: Họ thích thú đi dạo qua vùng nông thôn còn hoang sơ.

senses.vi: hoang sơ; chưa bị hủy hoại

thesaurus.definition: not left to spoil
not decayed or decomposed

vi_block: Không hư, không thối, không thiu (thức ăn).

examples: tourists descending on unspoiled areas
wiktionary.gloss: Not spoiled or touched; pure.

blocks.etymology: From French vacuole, from Medieval Latin vacuola, formed as a diminutive of Latin vacuus (“empty”).

thesaurus.definition: a tiny cavity filled with fluid in the cytoplasm of a cell

wiktionary.gloss: A large membrane-bound vesicle in a cell's cytoplasm.
A small empty or air-filled space or vacuity.

senses.definition: a particular way of thinking about something, or an opinion on a subject

examples.en: Try to look at the problem from the customer's viewpoint.
examples.vi: Hãy thử nhìn nhận vấn đề từ quan điểm của khách hàng.

senses.vi: quan điểm; góc nhìn

senses.definition: a physical place from which you can see a scene or landscape well

examples.en: The mountain cliff offers a spectacular viewpoint over the entire bay.
examples.vi: Vách núi đem đến một điểm ngắm cảnh ngoạn mục toàn bộ vịnh.

senses.vi: chỗ đứng nhìn tốt; điểm ngắm cảnh

thesaurus.definition: a mental position from which things are viewed
a place from which something can be viewed

vi_block: Chỗ đứng nhìn tốt, chỗ dễ nhìn.

examples: From the top of the hill you get a good viewpoint of the town.
wiktionary.gloss: The position from which something is observed or considered

examples: It is my personal viewpoint that veganism should be not only accepted, but actively encouraged by those in power.
wiktionary.gloss: An angle, outlook or point of view.

senses.definition: bent or twisted out of its original flat or straight shape, often from heat or moisture

examples.en: The wooden door is warped and will not close properly.
examples.vi: Cánh cửa gỗ bị cong vênh và không đóng khít được.

senses.vi: bị biến dạng; bị cong vênh

senses.definition: strange, abnormal, or unpleasant in a way that is not considered normal or healthy

examples.en: He has a warped sense of humor that makes people uncomfortable.
examples.vi: Anh ấy có khiếu hài hước lệch lạc khiến người khác khó chịu.

senses.vi: bị méo mó; lệch lạc; bệnh hoạn

vi_block: Bị biến dạng; bị bẻ cong.
Bị xuyên tạc; bị bóp méo.

wiktionary.gloss: Distorted by warping; twisted out of shape

examples: a warped sense of humour
wiktionary.gloss: Of a person's mind, attitudes, etc, perverse, strange, aberrant or deviant.

examples: Near-synonym: wave off
wiktionary.gloss: To reject or dismiss with a hand gesture.
To brush aside or sweep under the rug.

blocks.etymology: Originally a humorous allusion to a catchphrase popularized by the comedian Flip Wilson on American TV in the 1960s.

wiktionary.gloss: The image corresponds to the reality.
The screen image resembles the printed output.
